description: Per-frame overrides for the DISP-CAL algorithm (Venti plan T27). plate: ITRF2020-PMM plate for the plate_motion layer (PRD D3: NA default, PA Hawaii, CA Puerto Rico; California stays NA). tropo.mode and uncertainty.k_grid: from the trade studies (tropo_check, surface_fitting; k = 3.9 is the F08882 value used as a placeholder until TS-G1 fits it per frame). benchmark_category: PRD section 2.7. Values here are consumed once the T34/T35/T37 code paths land; with schema-v2 defaults they change nothing.
